title: TRAFICA: An Open Chromatin Language Model to Improve Transcription Factor Binding Affinity Prediction
authors: Yu Xu; Chonghao Wang; Ke Xu; Yi Ding; Aiping Lyu; Lu Zhang
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了开放染色质语言模型TRAFICA，结合ATAC-seq与体外TF-DNA结合谱预测TF-DNA结合亲和力，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作且采用AI方法，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: A bstract In silico transcription factor and DNA (TF-DNA) binding affinity prediction plays a vital role in examining TF binding preferences and understanding gene regulation. The existing tools employ TF-DNA binding profiles from in vitro high-throughput technologies to predict TF-DNA binding affinity. However, TFs tend to bind to sequences in open chromatin regions in vivo , such TF binding preference is seldomly considered by these existing tools. In this study, we developed TRAFICA, an open chromatin language model to predict TF-DNA binding affinity by integrating the characteristics of sequences from open chromatin regions in ATAC-seq experiments and in vitro TF-DNA binding profiles from high-throughput technologies. We applied self-supervised learning to pre-train TRAFICA on over 13 million nucleotide sequences from the peaks in ATAC-seq experiments to learn the TF binding preference in vivo . TRAFICA was further fine-tuned using the TF-DNA binding profiles from PBM and HT-SELEX technologies to learn the association between TFs and their target DNA sequences. We observed that TRAFICA significantly outperformed both machine learning-based and deep learning-based tools in predicting in vitro and in vivo TF-DNA binding affinity. These findings indicate that considering the characteristics of sequences from open chromatin regions could significantly improve TF-DNA binding affinity prediction, particularly when limited TF-DNA binding profiles from high-throughput technologies are available for specific TFs.
abstract_zh: 摘要 计算机模拟转录因子与DNA（TF-DNA）结合亲和力预测在检验TF结合偏好和理解基因调控中起着至关重要的作用。现有工具利用来自体外高通量技术的TF-DNA结合谱来预测TF-DNA结合亲和力。然而，TF在体内倾向于结合开放染色质区域中的序列，这种TF结合偏好很少被这些现有工具考虑。在本研究中，我们开发了TRAFICA，一种开放染色质语言模型，通过整合ATAC-seq实验中开放染色质区域序列的特征和来自高通量技术的体外TF-DNA结合谱来预测TF-DNA结合亲和力。我们应用自监督学习在ATAC-seq实验峰中的超过1300万个核苷酸序列上预训练TRAFICA，以学习体内TF结合偏好。TRAFICA进一步使用来自PBM和HT-SELEX技术的TF-DNA结合谱进行微调，以学习TF与其靶DNA序列之间的关联。我们观察到，TRAFICA在预测体外和体内TF-DNA结合亲和力方面显著优于基于机器学习和基于深度学习的工具。这些发现表明，考虑开放染色质区域序列的特征可以显著改善TF-DNA结合亲和力预测，特别是在特定TF可用的高通量技术TF-DNA结合谱有限的情况下。
